body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2010') -- <Visual News> Philips presented its potable DVD player with built-in TV receiver 'PET749' during Digital Experience at CES 2010.

A first in portable entertainment, this 2010 CES Innovation Honoree features a built-in TV receiver and offers free-to-air TV and DVD playback in a sleek form that epitomizes function, convenience and style. With the 7" TFT LCD screen, consumers can enjoy up to 3 hours of battery life to watch television, movies and listen to music on the go.
